pack.title: Exes resurfacing
pack.description: Decline contact you do not want.

scenarios.setting: An ex texts asking to meet and you do not want to reopen the relationship.
scenarios.jab: Come on, one coffee won't hurt.
scenarios.goal: Decline contact you do not want.

replies.line: I'm not reopening this. I wish you well.
replies.why: It states your decision without inviting a debate about the past.
replies.delivery: Stay neutral, say the boundary once, and end the exchange if it becomes repetitive.

replies.why: It answers the invitation directly without a negotiable excuse.
replies.delivery: Stay neutral, say the boundary once, and end the exchange if it becomes repetitive.

replies.line: I hope you're doing well; meeting isn't right for me, so I'll pass.
replies.why: It pairs goodwill with a clear refusal.
replies.delivery: Stay neutral, say the boundary once, and end the exchange if it becomes repetitive.

followUp.line: I hope you find it; I'm not available for that conversation.
followUp.why: It distinguishes their wish for closure from your obligation to provide contact.
followUp.delivery: Stay neutral, say the boundary once, and end the exchange if it becomes repetitive.
